newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore's '96 port container traffic up 9.3 pct.
newsitem.headline: Singapore's '96 port container traffic up 9.3 pct.

text.p: The Port of Authority of Singapore (PSA) said on Friday container traffic growth was a strong 9.3 percent in 1996 with a throughput of 12.95 million twenty-foot equivalent units (TEU).
"This is an increase of 1.1 million TEUs over the 11.85 million TEUs handled in 1995 and represents the world's highest container traffic growth in 1996," PSA said in a statement.

"With this strong performance, PSA has narrowed Hong Kong's lead. The number of containers handled by the colony, which grew by only 5.6 percent last year, registered 13.2 million TEUs for 1996," PSA said.
"The margin between Singapore and Hong Kong has narrowed from 650,000 TEUs for 1995 to 250,000 TEU's last year," it said.
